title: Repetitive intrusive thinking process: A transdiagnostic perspective framework for rumination, obsession and delusion
title_zh: 重复性侵入性思维过程：跨诊断视角框架用于沉思、强迫与妄想
abstract: The transdiagnostic approach has potentials to address the problems of comorbidity of diagnostic entities and heterogeneity in psychopathology. This approach may unveil the underlying mechanisms across different diagnostic entities. It is also important to study the potential risk factors for aggravating trajectories to develop specific psychiatric conditions. By extending the current theoretical models, we propose the repetitive-intrusive-thinking process (RITP) as a transdiagnostic framework to link rumination, obsession and delusion together as a continuum. Attention-control-deficit, cognitive-inflexibility, and impaired-reality-monitoring are core features of the self-referential RITP framework, associated with hyperactivation of the default-mode-network, and dysregulation of the salience network and the fronto-parietal network. Clarifying the shared mechanisms between rumination, obsession and delusion using the transdiagnostic perspective will benefit clinical care and facilitate personalized, domain-specific assessments and interventions across symptoms in psychiatric patients.
abstract_zh: 跨诊断方法有潜力解决诊断实体共病和精神病理异质性问题。该方法可揭示不同诊断实体之间的潜在机制，并研究加重轨迹的潜在风险因素，以发展特定精神疾病。基于现有理论模型的扩展，我们提出了重复性侵入性思维过程（RITP）作为跨诊断框架，将沉思、强迫和妄想作为连续体联系起来。注意力控制缺陷、认知僵化和现实监测受损是自我参照RITP框架的核心特征，伴随默认模式网络的过度激活以及显著网络和前额-顶叶网络的失调。利用跨诊断视角阐明沉思、强迫与妄想之间的共享机制，将有利于临床护理，并促进针对精神病患者症状的个性化、领域特定评估与干预。
